title: JetDeck pack (format 1)
description: A JetDeck declarative plugin pack. See format.md. JetDeck still validates every pack itself and computes the real risk; this schema is for editor help only.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and '-'. Reserved names and names starting with 'jetdeck-' are refused.

plugins.description: Plugins. May be empty when the pack has badges (a pack needs at least one plugin or one badge).

badges.description: Explorer badges (5.3.0, needs minApp 5.3.0). Run automatically when you open a folder in the Explorer. Max 2 for packs you install yourself.

permissions.description: App feature permissions (6.0.0, needs minApp 6.0.0). Actions with mode "app" use them by id. Packs you install yourself or publish to the gallery: max 3.

minApp.description: At least 6.1.0 when a permission has kind serial.read.
At least 6.0.0 when the pack has permissions or mode "app" actions.

cmd.description: Command to run. Must contain {dir} exactly as a bare word (JetDeck fills in the opened folder and quotes it). JetDeck must prove the command is read-only, or the badge is dropped. No other {slots}.

root.description: dir: paths are relative to the opened folder. line1: the first output line is the absolute base folder (for example a Git top folder).

match.description: Regular expression applied to each record.

code.description: Capture group number of the status code.

path.description: Capture group number of the file path.

show.description: 1-2 visible characters shown next to the item.

tone.description: Color is chosen by JetDeck, not the pack.

codes.description: Only the codes listed here are shown.

tag.description: Regular expression with one group. The group of the first matching record is shown (max 40 characters) beside the base folder name.

ttl.description: Minimum seconds before the same base folder is read again.

text60.description: Plain text or { ko, en }. Max 60 characters.

text300.description: Plain text or { ko, en }. Max 300 characters.

text500.description: Plain text or { ko, en }. Max 500 characters.

kind.description: sftp.read: list, download and read text files under root. sftp.write: upload files under root. tunnel: connect one Device port to 127.0.0.1 on this PC (local forwarding only). serial.read (6.1.0, needs minApp 6.1.0): read a serial port of this PC and show the text. Read-only: the pack cannot send anything. You pick the port every time.

root.description: sftp only. A folder under the home folder, for example ~/logs. Not ~ itself, no .., no sensitive folders (.ssh, .aws, ...).

maxBytes.description: sftp and serial.read. Size limit of one file (sftp) or of all received bytes (serial.read), in bytes.

overwrite.description: sftp.write only. ask: the confirm dialog says the file will be overwritten. never: refuse if the file exists.

remotePort.description: tunnel only. Device port. Ports of unauthenticated admin services are refused: 2375, 3389, 5900-5909, 6379, 9200, 11211, 27017.

maxMinutes.description: tunnel and serial.read. The tunnel or the serial read ends after this many minutes.

baud.description: serial.read only. Required. Only these baud rates are allowed. The port itself is never named in a pack.

then.description: mode app (6.0.0): uses a permission. No cmd, auto, sudo, preview, display, confirm, params, timeout.

cmd.description: Do not write sudo; use "sudo": true. {name} is replaced by a choice from params.

risk.description: What you claim. JetDeck computes the real risk and uses the higher one.

mode.description: stream (5.1.0, needs minApp 5.1.0): output that keeps coming, shown live with display.type log. app (6.0.0, needs minApp 6.0.0): uses a permission from permissions.

perm.description: mode app only. The id of a permission in permissions.

op.description: mode app only. sftp.read: list, get, text. sftp.write: put. tunnel: open. serial.read: read.

path.description: mode app only. Path under the permission root, relative, no .. and no leading /. {name} slots are filled from fields. Not for open.

params.description: Fixed choices. Use either params or fields, not both.

fields.description: Input form (5.1.0, needs minApp 5.1.0). Each name fills the {name} slot in cmd.

timeout.description: Seconds. exec: default 60, max 600. stream: the longest it may run, default 600, max 3600.

stopGrace.description: stream only (5.4.0, needs minApp 5.4.0). Seconds to wait after Ctrl-C before the channel is closed. Default 3. External packs: max 10. Official packs: max 30.

default.description: A string (for int too, for example "50"); a boolean for flag.

choices.description: select: fixed choices, same as params.

from.description: select: choices read from the Device. The command must be read-only. It runs when the screen opens.

maxLen.description: text: max 200, default 60. path: max 300, default 300.

on.description: flag only: the text inserted when the box is checked.

maxLines.description: log only: lines kept on screen. Default 1000.

split.description: table: ws or tab. chart: ws, tab or csv.

skip.description: Header lines to skip. chart: only with split.

every.description: chart only (5.2.0, needs minApp 5.2.0): seconds between reads. Packs you install yourself: at least 1.

points.description: chart only: points kept on screen.

unit.description: chart only: unit text, for example ℃.

perLine.description: chart only, with match: one line per matching output line. {1} in the label is the first match group (letters, digits, _ . - and at most 20 characters; other lines are dropped).

value.description: Number of the match group that holds the value.

scale.description: Multiplier. Example: 0.001 turns millidegrees into degrees.

series.description: chart only: a fixed list of lines. With match, each has a key (match needs exactly 2 groups: name, value). With split, each has a col (1 to 50).

min.description: chart only: bottom of the vertical range. Must be below max.

max.description: chart only: top of the vertical range.

then.description: chart: exactly one of match or split, exactly one of perLine or series. The action must use mode exec, risk read, and none of fields, params, sudo, preview.
